optimizations.currentTitle: The Hidden Dangers of Indoor Heating on Blood Pressure
optimizations.suggestedTitle: Does Heat Raise or Lower Blood Pressure? What Science Says for Adults 35+
optimizations.suggestedDescription: New evidence shows heat can both increase AND decrease BP—depending on age, hydration, and meds. Learn why hot weather affects your readings and how to stay safe.
optimizations.suggestedPK: does heat raise or lower blood pressure
